stepBody: See image. Only type what is in the blank, do not include what is provided. Do not use spaces unless absolutely necessary. Please use double quotes (" "), instead of single quotes (' '). If you are utilizing the table, please use the numbers in order.##figure6.gif##

figureAlts.figure6.gif: (f) Write code that simulates playing the carnival game 1000 times, and returns an array of proportions corresponding to how often each prize was won. A fill-in-the-blank code block with two lines. The first line is "prize_chances =" followed by Blank 1. The second line is "my_simulation =" followed by Blank 2.
